name: scroll-stitcher
description: 滚动驱动的叙事拼贴组合器
interaction: As the user scrolls, fragmented images and text snippets dynamically stitch together along a shared horizontal thread, building a cohesive visual narrative. Scroll speed controls the stitching rhythm — fast scrolls create rapid overlaps while slow scrolls reveal delicate connections between elements, making each journey through the page a unique collage.
